title: A Free Sample and Launch Week
lessons: The player sees an offer to try a new Liquid I.V. flavor as a free sample rather than buying a full bag immediately.
The player is already subscribed and can add a free sample of a new flavor to an upcoming order during launch week.

text: A little card in the mail: try the new Liquid I.V. flavor, one packet, free. No bag to buy.

entry-first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: New flavor, one packet. I'd rather hand you one than make you bet a whole bag on my taste in flavors.

choice-first.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Come on. It's one packet. What's the hesitation?

choices.text: I'd try one before buying a box.
Free usually means you want my email or my next order.
I don't need one more wellness sample in the cabinet.

first-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Good. Make it in your own glass, in your own kitchen, on a normal night. That's the only test I actually care about.

first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Usually, yes. I'm not going to pretend otherwise. I'm hoping you like it enough to buy it later. That's the whole trade, and you get a packet out of it either way.

first-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then even free is too much cabinet. Fine. No hard feelings, and I mean that.
Launch week. Your subscription box is already on its way, and there's an option to tuck a free packet of the new flavor in with it.

entry-return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: You've got a box coming this week anyway. Want the new one tucked in with it?

entry-return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: During launch week, yes. It goes in the box you're already getting. No extra order, no extra wait.

entry-return-5.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: I packed for both of us. That's basically my whole personality.

choice-return.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Yes or no. The box leaves tomorrow.

choices.text: That's a good way to get me to actually try it.
You're using my subscription box as an ad slot.
Don't turn every refill into a product launch.

return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Right? Same box, one more packet, nothing new to find room for. Easiest sample I've ever done.

return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: I am. I'm not going to apologize for it either. Your box is the best place I've got to show you the next thing, and I'm going to use it.

return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Fair. A refill can just be a refill. I'll leave it out next time. I'll want to tell you about it, but I'll leave it out.
